title: ai-atoms template v1
description: A template atom — a document skeleton a runtime renders by filling placeholders: an ADR, a runbook, a HANDOFF.md, a plan, a pull-request body. It carries the skeleton itself, the placeholders it expects, and one rendered example.

subtype.description: The kind of document the template produces.

body.description: The skeleton. Placeholders are written {{name}} and must each appear in `placeholders`. Everything else is emitted verbatim.

placeholders.description: Every {{name}} the body uses, in order of first appearance.

description.description: What goes here, as instruction to whoever fills it.

required.description: Whether the rendered document is invalid without it. Default true.

example.description: A filled value, so the reader sees the shape.
One complete rendered instance of the template.

rules.description: Constraints on the rendered document that the skeleton alone cannot express (line length, forbidden words, ordering).

produced_by.description: Skill atoms whose output is this document.
